name: Alt Spam Helper
description: Imports GDR1 replay files and analyses alternating-button input patterns. GDR2 is not yet supported.

macro_file.name: Import macro
macro_file.description: Choose a macro file. The mod analyses it after selection.

macro_status.name: Macro analysis
macro_status.description: Shows the result of the latest replay import.

helper_enabled.name: Helper Enabled
helper_enabled.description: Reserved toggle for the future gameplay helper; no automated tapping is implemented yet.

spam_cps.name: Tap rate
spam_cps.description: Reserved setting for a future helper; changing this currently has no gameplay effect.
